		PRODUCT_FLAG as string,

		DATE_OF_SERVICE as string,
		RESULT_TEXT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		RESULT_VALUE,
		PATIENT_IDENTIFIER,
		LOINC_CODE,
		PRODUCT_FLAG,
		RESULT_UNITS,
		DATE_OF_SERVICE,
		RESULT_TEXT)) ~> FlatFileDestination
